title: CrewAI Manager
description: Multi-agent manager using CrewAI hierarchical process.
Fans out to connected CrewAI Subagent nodes, assembles a Crew, and synthesizes their outputs.
Can be invoked as a tool (`<nodeId>.run_agent`) for nested orchestration.

llm.description: LLM used by the manager agent

tool.description: Cross-cutting tools available to the manager itself (via control-plane invoke)

agent_description.title: Agent description
agent_description.description: What this manager + its sub-agent crew does. Used by parent agents that call this manager as a tool via `<nodeId>.run_agent` to decide when to invoke it.

instructions.title: Instructions
instructions.description: Additional instructions to guide the manager's delegation strategy.

require_tool_call.title: Require tool call
require_tool_call.description: Require at least one tool call (including calls delegated to sub-agents) before answering. When on, a run that answers without any tool invocation fails with a guard error. Use for determinism-critical pipelines where an ungrounded or narrated answer must never be delivered. Off by default.

advanced_mode.title: Advanced Mode
advanced_mode.description: Expose CrewAI manager Agent configuration directly.

goal.title: Manager Goal
goal.description: What the manager is trying to achieve. Maps to CrewAI Agent(goal=...).

backstory.title: Manager Backstory
backstory.description: Background context for the manager's persona. Maps to CrewAI Agent(backstory=...).

planning.title: Crew Planning
planning.description: Run CrewAI's planner before the crew executes, adding a step-by-step plan to each task. Off by default: the planner requires the LLM to return JSON matching CrewAI's plan schema, and a model that answers in prose instead fails the whole run with Failed to get the Planning output. It also costs one extra LLM call per kickoff. Enable only with a model that reliably emits well-formed JSON.
